symptom: The stage01_seed_replay probe trained on soda-creek seeds 63400-63402 for 512 timesteps but still left seed 63402 as a 60s opening death, kept 300s high-pressure win rate at 0.0 on all three maps, and failed same-seed parent no-regression on soda-creek 180s.
root_cause: Explicitly replaying the three validation seeds was not enough to learn the failing opening recovery state. The continuation improved some non-target windows but reduced soda-creek 180s win rate from 0.6667 to 0.3333 and average survival by 11.4358s, so the repair shifted the failure surface instead of clearing it.
fix: Do not continue from the seed replay checkpoint. The next stage 01 attempt should collect or trace the seed 63402 failing state, add a narrower opening retention objective or action guard, and rerun same-seed 60/180/300s parent no-regression before any stage 02 handoff work.
validation: Fixed-window high-pressure comparisons were run for 60/180/300 seconds at seed_start 63400, then validate_policy_window_regression.py compared the candidate against the same-seed parent baseline. The regression report returned policy_window_regression_failed with blockers on 180s/soda-creek win_rate_delta -0.3334 and average_survival_seconds -11.4358s.
